title: Vijayanagara administration: more terms and detail

boxes.title: Amuktamalyada maxims
items: **Spy system** + ambassadors (**sthanapatis**) essential
Improve **harbours**; import ==**horses, elephants, gems**==; treat foreign merchants generously
Build **tanks, irrigation**; win over **forest tribes**
Rule by **Dharma**; records dynasty genealogy, not campaigns

boxes.title: Provinces & governors
items: Head also **Durga Dannayaka**; office = ==**Chavadi**==; sub-district also **Kampana** (**Kavalgar**)
Seema head also **Parupatyandaru**; prominent rajyams: **Udayagiri, Chandragiri, Kondaveedu**
**Vanitas**: Aravidu sub-units of **Udayagiri, Penukonda**, Hampi rajyams
Powers: ==**mint coins**==, remit / levy taxes, own armies
Control: frequent transfers; **Brahmins** as dannayakas on borders

boxes.title: Amaram: more
head: Point
Fact
rows: More autonomy than Durgadannayakas; king could remove them
Uyyalawada **Narasimha Reddy** (1840s, **Koilkuntla** treasury); Kurnool Nawabs deposed **1839**; **Banganapalle** semi-independent

boxes.title: Tax policy & ayagars
items: Marriage tax first lifted in areas by **Saluva Narasimha** ⚠ other notes: **Vira Narasimha**
==**Kondaju** abolished by **Sadashiva Raya**==
Market tolls auctioned to **Sunkandarlu**
Ayagars also: **Purohita, Kamsali, Kummari, Vadrangi, Kase, Kammari, Chakali, Mangali, Madiga**
**Begari**: forced labour (vetti)

boxes.title: Army & justice: more
items: Standing army about **50,000** (Nuniz)
Krishnadevaraya: **24,000** horses, **1,200** elephants, **5 lakh** infantry
**Chenchus, Koyas, Boyas** + Muslim troops; horse trade → ==**bullion drain**==
Law: **Parashara Madhaviyam** (Madhavacharya); Timmarusu = **Dharma Pratipalaka**
**Mudrita** / **Shastrita**; **Himsodbhava** (criminal) / **Dhanodbhava** (civil)
Brahmins: **life imprisonment**; **divine ordeals** (Conti)
